# Test fixtures

## `CMU-1-Small-Region.svs`

A small (1.85MB), single-pyramid-level Aperio SVS file, used by `slide.rs`
and `dataset.rs` tests that need a real, valid WSI to open and decode tiles
from.

- Source: [OpenSlide test data](https://openslide.cs.cmu.edu/download/openslide-testdata/Aperio/CMU-1-Small-Region.svs)
- License: [CC0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) (public domain)
